analyticalQuestion: What are the latest annual company-wide revenue, capex, and R&D observations by company?
comparabilityRequirements: No layer-wide or market-wide financial totals.
Annual and interim observations are not mixed.
Missing and withheld values remain unavailable, not zero.
Company-wide financial observations are not AI-specific allocations.
limitationText: Companies have different fiscal calendars; values are company-wide and not AI-specific allocations.
metricDefinition: Latest annual company-wide source-attributed observations, displayed by actual fiscal year and period end.
